header: L3 · The maintainer three years from now · sonnet
verdict: The round-14 pass closes the reset gap of RJ-338 and moves the narrowing record to a named note, but the event the four Deferred rows cite still has no entry format or deciding entry, and the surrounding text contradicts where its answers go; largest gap L3-r15-1.

prior_resolution_notes.L3-r14-1: R14-02 promised the event defined in the note with A16, key list and four tries, and rows citing it: present; entry format and deciding entry were not promised, see L3-r15-1.
prior_resolution_notes.L3-r14-2: R14-01: RJ-338 now states the row, that a resume writes no entry, and I17 holds the extra-edit case: present.
prior_resolution_notes.L3-r14-3: R14-09: cell lists the values and writers, lost record is requested (decided by the pass): present; residual in L3-r15-4.
prior_resolution_notes.L3-r14-4: R14-05 (M): pending tries are items g and h, d keeps what ran, ruleset-disable try named: present; operator/maintainer names left, as stated.
prior_resolution_notes.L3-r14-5: R14-10 (M): history moved to the round page; I17 split left to the task, as stated; see L3-r15-5.

findings.section: 10 10.2 (item g); docs/notes/maintainer-block-of-ci-bootstrap.md (The token narrowing); index Deferred decisions (four rows)
findings.defect: The event 'the token is narrowed' is 'a dated entry', but the entry has no format, may say the token is NOT narrowed, and no text says which entry decides.
findings.scenario: Three years on, the note holds a first entry that says not narrowed, a later positive one and a still later read that shows a widened token. The rows say 'as the dated entry ... records it'; a reader cannot tell whether the rows fired at the first entry, the positive one, or were un-fired. The closing line 'No entry yet: the narrowing waits for a maintainer step' is never told to be deleted and stays beside the first entry. Item h saves answers 'under the entry of item g' with several entries possible.
findings.change: In the note fix an entry heading (date, verdict 'narrowed' or 'not narrowed') and say the rows fire at the first entry with verdict narrowed, a later negative read is a new Deferred-row question not an un-fire, item g replaces the 'No entry yet' line, and item h names the entry by its date. Cost: about four sentences in the note, a few words in item g and h.
findings.evidence: 10-testing-style.md item g 'a dated entry of the note ... means the token is not narrowed, and the entry says so'; note 'The maintainer adds one dated entry when the narrowing is applied, and one for each later read' and last line 'No entry yet: the narrowing waits for a maintainer step.'; spec.md:279,283,351,353 'as the dated entry of 10 10.2, item g, records it'; 10 10.2 item h 'save the API answers under the entry of item g'.

findings.section: 10 10.2 (maintainer block: lead-in of 'To do', rule of 'The output of each item')
findings.defect: The maintainer block still says every item's output goes under a pull request's Evidence, and the To do list says each item 'saves the API's answer under Evidence', while item g says its answers go in the note 'not under a pull request's Evidence'.
findings.scenario: A maintainer who follows the list header saves the item g reads under a PR that has no relation to them, and the record the Deferred rows cite stays empty; a check-minded agent reads the header as the rule.
findings.change: Reword the two general sentences to 'under the Evidence of the PR it belongs to, or, for items g and h, in the entry of the note'. Cost: one clause twice.
findings.evidence: 10-testing-style.md:843 'The output of each item goes under the Evidence of the PR it belongs to'; 'To do, each a maintainer step that saves the API's answer under Evidence:'; item g 'not under a pull request's Evidence'.

findings.section: docs/plan.md (maintainer blocks O1 to O7); 10 10.2 items g, h
findings.defect: Items g and h are maintainer steps that appear in no sitting of the plan's O table, so no one schedules them.
findings.scenario: O1 covers items a to d and O2 item e; g and h wait on 'a maintainer step' that the plan never lists, so the Deferred rows stay unfired by neglect, not by decision.
findings.change: Add an O row (or a clause in O2 or O5) that names items g and h and the order g then h; cost one row.
findings.evidence: plan.md O1 'items a to d (10 10.2)', O2 'item e (10 10.2)'; no row names item g or h (grep of the O table).

findings.defect: A lost record from crash recovery now carries cause 'requested', and the cell neither says that a new value needs a format change nor separates 'a command's own run' from 'a rerun started'.
findings.scenario: A reader of the state file sees cause 'requested' on a record nobody requested, and a later automatic salvage will be filed under the same word because 'requested' is defined by exclusion ('on its own run').
findings.change: State that requested also marks the lost record and means 'not started by a changed fingerprint', and that a third value needs a state-format version change. Cost: one sentence.
findings.evidence: 03-formats.md:483 'requested for an entry a command writes on its own run, that is salvage ..., and the lost record a command writes when it finds the sandbox absent'.

findings.defect: The decision to split the I17 cell into titled cases is recorded only on the round-14 page, not in the task that writes the tests.
findings.scenario: The T062 author reads its acceptance list, finds no instruction, and writes one test per cell clause or one test for the cell; case titles cannot then be cited.
findings.change: Add a line to the plan task that implements I17 (T062): one titled case per E: clause. Cost: one line.
findings.evidence: round-14.md 'Splitting the I17 cell into titled cases is left to the task that writes the I17 tests'; plan.md T062 acceptance 'rm exits 5 for each case of I17' names no splitting.

what_is_missing: A fixed entry format and a deciding-entry rule for the narrowing record; plan sittings for items g and h; a note in T062 to split I17; a format-change rule for new cause values.
postmortem: After v1.0.0 the maintainer cannot tell whether the token is narrowed or whether the four Deferred rows fired: the record is prose with a stale placeholder, answers are told to go to two places, and no sitting schedules the steps (10 10.2, note, index, plan).
lens_critique: The lens measures concept count and drift well but rewards fewer words over a stated procedure; for this product a maintainer step with no check needs a fixed record format more than it needs brevity.
out_of_scope: The operator versus maintainer names (left to the vocabulary round); the 2026-10-07 versus 2026-10-08 date mismatch in the note (already recorded as found and unchanged).
confidence: medium: read the delta and the sections it cites, not every citing page; the grep for O-table rows was narrow.
